name: Equalizer Exchange
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: On May 14th, the decentralized trading protocol Equalizer Exchange within the Fantom ecosystem was suspected to have been attacked. The official team tweeted that they are investigating the incident and advised users not to interact with the Equalizer Exchange frontend. On May 15th, Equalizer Exchange announced that the domain has been restored.
